Principal limitation: The selected excerpt chiefly questions whether competing groups derive from Jesus and gestures toward hostile markers, leaving the stated patristic sourcing proposition only partially recoverable and failing to answer unknown-source, authorial-selection, copying, and independence objections. Live burden: The affirmative must identify the relevant testimony, establish dating and informational independence, and explain why convergence is not produced by shared transmission or retrospective selection.
